name: moai-lang-php
description: PHP 8.4+ best practices with PHPUnit 11, Composer, PSR-12, Laravel, Symfony.
Allowed tools: Read (read_file), Bash (terminal). Auto-load on keywords.
Supports TDD, TRUST 5, `/alfred:2-run`, code discussions, SPEC implementation, reviews, features.
Versions: PHP 8.4.0; PHPUnit 11.5.0; Composer 2.8.0; Laravel 12.0.0; Symfony 7.3.5.
Use language source directories, tests/data, execution plans, TRUST 5 checkpoints. Integrate `moai-foundation-langs` and `moai-foundation-trust`. Handle missing tools/dependencies and coverage below 85%. Maintain test coverage ≥85%. Document all public APIs. Follow language best practices. Use latest stable tool versions. Never Skip quality gates. Never Use deprecated tools. Never Ignore security warnings. Never Mix testing frameworks.
